purpose: Teach: 恐るべき/逆行/あの世/極意/陳腐/囚われ/円満/時代遅れ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは恐るべき洞察力で人を見抜かれるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has this terrifying way of seeing right through people.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering tone. Speaking to herself as much as to Sho. A quiet pause before 'terrifying' — not quite a flinch, but recognition. Warm underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、流行に逆行する漫画好きなんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I like manga that goes against what's trendy.
lines.style: Quick, bright announcement — a kid sharing something he's proud of. Slight rush at the start, then settling. Eyes up, looking for her reaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「あの世から見守る」って言葉を仰ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said something about 'watching over us from the other side.'
lines.style: Careful, reverent delivery. Spaces the phrase out slightly, honoring the weight of it. Her voice goes softer on 'other side' — almost uncertain, like she's still processing it herself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが料理の極意を教えて下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me the real secret to cooking.
lines.style: Bright, reaching-upward tone. The rhythm of a child wanting to share something precious. A small pause after 'secret' — building toward it. Genuine pride underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、陳腐な感想じゃなく自分の心を伝えてね
lines.en: Sho, tell me what's really in your heart — not something you think sounds good.
lines.style: Gentle but direct. Leans in slightly. Not asking, inviting. A steady warmth underneath the instruction. The pause before 'really' is kind, not demanding.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、心配に囚われすぎないよう気を付けるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm trying not to let worry trap me like it used to.
lines.style: Slower than before. Thoughtful, almost resolute. The voice of a small child speaking something he's been sitting with. Quiet conviction, not boasting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家が円満なのが何より大事ね
lines.en: Sho, what matters most is that your home is full of peace.
lines.style: Warm, almost maternal in delivery. Each word placed carefully, like she's handing him something to hold. Slight trailing-off at the end — a benediction, not a lecture.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、時代遅れのおもちゃも大切にしてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I still take care of the old toys I loved when I was little.
lines.style: Soft, genuine. A smile underneath the words. Slow, meandering pace — he's savoring the memory. Trailing warmth at the end, like a small confession of something precious.
